description: Custom astroboii47 build based on Gboard Patches 4.5.0-dev.7. Fixes a SoftKeyboardView verifier crash when combining the clipboard Select All hook with GinType. Includes emoji and symbol shortcodes, optional quick GIF queries, smoother cursor trackpad movement, tuned smooth character deletion, and the latest upstream features. When combining with GinType, enable Package Rename in this bundle only.
